mapper.insert: insert into event_decisions(event_id,tenant_id,source_system,event_type,event_stage,correlation_id,normalized_message,payload_json,occurred_at,fingerprint,incident_id,decision_type,duplicate,occurrence_count,actions_json,reason,decided_at) values(#{decision.eventId},#{decision.tenantId},#{decision.sourceSystem},#{decision.eventType},#{decision.eventStage},#{decision.correlationId},#{decision.normalizedMessage},coalesce(cast(#{decision.payloadJson} as jsonb),'{}'::jsonb),#{decision.occurredAt},#{decision.fingerprint},#{decision.incidentId},#{decision.decisionType},#{decision.duplicate},#{decision.occurrenceCount},coalesce(cast(#{decision.actionsJson} as jsonb),'[]'::jsonb),#{decision.reason},#{decision.decidedAt}) on conflict(event_id) do update set tenant_id=excluded.tenant_id,source_system=excluded.source_system,event_type=excluded.event_type,event_stage=excluded.event_stage,correlation_id=excluded.correlation_id,normalized_message=excluded.normalized_message,payload_json=excluded.payload_json,occurred_at=excluded.occurred_at,fingerprint=excluded.fingerprint,incident_id=excluded.incident_id,decision_type=excluded.decision_type,duplicate=excluded.duplicate,occurrence_count=excluded.occurrence_count,actions_json=excluded.actions_json,reason=excluded.reason,decided_at=excluded.decided_at
mapper.select: select event_id,tenant_id,source_system,event_type,event_stage,correlation_id,normalized_message,payload_json,occurred_at,fingerprint,incident_id,decision_type,duplicate,occurrence_count,actions_json,reason,decided_at,owner_department_id,owner_group_id,scope_status,scope_source_version,scope_inherited_at from event_decisions order by decided_at desc limit #{limit}
